title: repro run rotates each instance's area order by the manifest's instance count, so a rerun with fewer instances keeps each order
goal: bench_repro.run passes area_order the instance count of instances.json, not this run's --instances, and refuses a rerun whose orders differ from the orders run.json recorded (the changed answer of ST-eefdl6am g1), so one instance's results never mix two orders

run:
import io,json,os,sys,tempfile;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bench_repro as b
from pathlib import Path
r=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
ins=[{'n':n,'bare':str(r/f'o{n}.git'),'clone':str(r/f'c{n}'),'mcp_config':str(r/f'm{n}.json'),'lock_dir':str(r/f'l{n}')} for n in (1,2,3)]
(r/'instances.json').write_text(json.dumps({'rev':'','source':'x','instances':ins}))
o=[];b.run(count=2,root=r,dry_run=True,out=o.append)
br=b.load_briefs();want=', '.join(x['area'].strip() for x in b.area_order(br,2,3))
i=[k for k,l in enumerate(o) if l.startswith('instance 2:')][0];got=[l for l in o[i:] if l.startswith('  order: ')][0].split('order: ',1)[1]
print(got[:60]);sys.exit(0 if got==want else 1)
